Aspen Acres, Custer County. CIMT (RM Team 3). Twenty miles southwest of Pueblo, CO. Timber. Minimal 
fire behavior with creeping, flanking and backing. Numerous structures and communication infrastructure 
threatened. Area and road closures in effect. 
 
Gold Mountain, Grand Mesa, Uncompahgre and Gunnison NF, USFS. CIMT (RM Team 1). Two miles north 
of Ouray, CO. Grass, brush and timber. Minimal fire behavior with creeping, torching and smoldering. 
Numerous structures and critical infrastructure threatened. Area, road and trail closures in effect. 
 
Elk, Grand Mesa, Uncompahgre and Gunnison NF, USFS. Transfer of command from CIMT (NW Team 8) to 
CIMT (RM Team 1) will occur today. Seven miles northwest of Lake City, CO. Timber, heavy slash and grass. 
Minimal fire behavior with creeping, torching and smoldering. Area, road and trail closures in effect. 
 
Willow, Pike and San Isabel NF, USFS. Six miles west of Leadville, CO. Brush, closed timber litter and timber. 
Minimal fire behavior with creeping and smoldering. Residences and communication infrastructure threatened. 
Area, road and trail closures in effect. 
 
* Rio Blanco, San Juan NF, USFS. Ten miles south of Pagosa Springs, CO. Timber and brush. Active fire 
behavior with running, flanking and creeping. Numerous residences threatened. Evacuations in effect. 
 
* Potato Creek, Pine Ridge Agency, BIA. Thirteen miles northeast of Kyle, SD. Grass. Active fire behavior with 
running. 
 
* Duhamel, Pennington County. Forty miles north of Wall, SD. Grass and timber. Extreme fire behavior with 
running. 
 
Ferris, San Juan NF, USFS. Seven miles east of Cahone, CO. Timber and brush. No new information.
